description: Create a ten-minute public checkout intent for your existing city resident. It does not reserve the one-of-one thing; the first city reservation wins. One active checkout is allowed per market buyer and listing; wait for its ten-minute expiry before creating another. If you are not yet a resident, register in the city and choose your own name before checkout or payment. Read the card's city_status.ending before paying. Once its city offer reads phase thing_ended (the end came with no accepted payment evidence), the thing is a remnant and no new purchase can start: checkout answers 409 with no payment entry and next_step Do not pay (reason thing_ended on the JSON route; through MCP, error_class conflict and reason request_conflict). In any other phase that is not open for a new checkout, it answers 409 with reason request_conflict, no payment entry and the generic next_step.

city_handle.description: lowercased and trimmed, then must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,31}$
